verses: And afterward, I put forth the first footstep to the star track, on Humat, the place where good thoughts are received with hospitality. And I saw those souls of the pious whose radiance, which ever increased, was glittering as the stars; and their throne and seat were under the radiance, and splendid and full of glory.
And I asked Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, thus: 'Which place is this? and which people are these?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This place is the star track; and those are the souls who, in the world, offered no prayers, and chanted no Gathas, and contracted no next-of-kin marriage; they have also exercised no sovereignty, nor rulership nor chieftainship. Through other good works they have become pious.'
